purpose: Teach: 初代/何者/イスラム教/首長/巡礼/検閲/押収/老朽

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療チーム、本気で、絶対、初代、絶対、院長の、絶対、教え、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, our medical team has genuinely carried forward the original director's teachings with complete dedication.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Clear and direct without rushing. Quiet pride in what the institution has maintained. Even breath, professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、何者、絶対、か、絶対、不明の、絶対、患者さん、絶対、診られたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So your hospital genuinely treated a patient whose background was completely unknown to us?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Thoughtful pause before the question. Respectful tone asking something he doesn't fully understand yet. Seeking clarity, not challenging.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、イスラム教、絶対、の患者さん、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、宗教配慮しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We make genuine effort to provide our Muslim patients with medical care that respects their religious beliefs and needs.
lines.style: Clear, informative delivery without lecturing. Calm, matter-of-fact. A statement of practice, not pride. Steady eye contact. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外、本気で、絶対、首長、絶対、国、絶対、医療制度、絶対、貴院、絶対、研究されたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I see — so your hospital has actually studied the healthcare systems in countries with Islamic leadership?
lines.style: Thoughtful, respectful tone. Slow, considering pace. Voice carries genuine interest and a hint of admiration. Not a challenge — an observation of thoroughness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。巡礼、本気で、絶対、シーズン、絶対、患者さん、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、対応、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. During pilgrimage season especially, our medical team is prepared to care for patients with that context in mind.
lines.style: Patient, grounded delivery. Speaking from experience, not theory. Warm but professional. A gentle confirmation that this is part of regular practice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療情報の、本気で、絶対、検閲、絶対、貴院、絶対、慎重に、絶対、扱われているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And I understand your hospital handles sensitive medical information with real caution?
lines.style: Respectful, thoughtful question. Soft, deferential tone — asking about something delicate. Pause before the final phrase, letting the seriousness land.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。違法薬物の、本気で、絶対、押収、絶対、警察と、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、連携しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We coordinate with police when illegal substances are involved, but our medical team's first responsibility is always patient care.
lines.style: Steady, composed. Matter-of-fact without coldness. Patient, clear explanation of balance between obligations. Professional and measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、老朽、絶対、病棟の、絶対、改修、絶対、貴院、絶対、進められたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And your hospital is actually moving forward with renovations to the aging ward sections?
lines.style: Reflective, quiet admiration in the tone. Soft, wondering voice — this is a practical detail that speaks to institutional care. Trailing slightly, as if taking in what this means.
